description: myMaison interior design colour palettes — 56 options across modern neutrals, naturals, soft pastels, heritage frameworks and bold accents. Each palette carries persona_fit + timelessness so the brief synthesiser can match palette to person, not just to trend. Palettes tagged "popular" surface in the dashboard carousel + the wizard's featured chooser; the full set is browseable at /palettes.

palettes.name: Warm Grounded Earth
palettes.trend_source: Dominant 2026 designer trend — LUXE Interiors + Design
palettes.app_note: Default palette — broadest appeal, pairs with almost any furniture

palettes.name: Transformative Teal
palettes.app_note: Strong statement palette — flag as bold in the UI

palettes.name: Honest Essentials
palettes.trend_source: Sherwin-Williams 2026 Colour Collection of the Year
palettes.app_note: Ideal for whole-home consistency — use as neutral base preset

palettes.name: Silhouette & Pale
palettes.trend_source: Benjamin Moore Colour of the Year 2026
palettes.app_note: Premium feel — pair with Poliform or Coco Republic product renders

palettes.name: Misty Blue Neutral
palettes.app_note: Broadest demographic appeal — great default for bedroom renders

palettes.name: Warm Mahogany & Clay
palettes.app_note: Bold and warm — best for dining and statement rooms

palettes.name: Mossy Green & Ochre
palettes.app_note: Works well for GlobeWest outdoor and indoor-outdoor renders

palettes.name: Pistachio & Chocolate
palettes.app_note: Trend-forward — flag as seasonal trend with 2026 badge

palettes.name: Pale Mint & Sea Breeze
palettes.app_note: Strong AU market appeal — coastal / Queensland aesthetic

palettes.name: Tomato Red & Umber
palettes.app_note: Reserve for accent or feature renders — too bold for full-room default

palettes.name: Australian Federation
palettes.app_note: Heritage AU homes — Federation, Edwardian period builds with stained timber and leadlight

palettes.name: Hamptons Heritage
palettes.trend_source: Timeless framework — Classic Hamptons residential canon
palettes.app_note: Classic Hamptons palette — cream slipcovers, navy accents, polished brass

palettes.name: Mid-Century Walnut
palettes.app_note: Established 60-year-old palette — walnut + mustard + teal accents. Boyd-era Australian modernism.

palettes.name: Coastal Whitewash
palettes.app_note: AU coastal-relaxed palette — Byron, Noosa, Mornington vernacular. Never out of fashion.

palettes.name: English Country
palettes.trend_source: Timeless framework — English country residential canon
palettes.app_note: Heritage cottage palette — soft sage, dusty rose, cream layered with characterful texture

palettes.name: Modernist Restraint
palettes.app_note: Timeless modernist palette — concrete, pale oak, considered black. Mies and Aalto territory.

palettes.name: White Dove Calm
palettes.trend_source: Benjamin Moore White Dove — most-specified modern white
palettes.app_note: Modern white-on-white — the safest popular pick. Pairs with almost any furniture.

palettes.name: Swiss Coffee Warm
palettes.trend_source: Benjamin Moore Swiss Coffee — warm-white classic
palettes.app_note: Warm-cream alternative to White Dove — better with timber-heavy interiors.

palettes.name: Greige Sanctuary
palettes.app_note: Warm grey-beige — the most broadly liveable neutral. Excellent default.

palettes.name: Mushroom & Bone
palettes.app_note: Quiet luxury palette — works hard at the high end without trying.

palettes.name: Oat & Linen
palettes.app_note: Light Japandi — gentle warm neutrals, lots of natural texture.

palettes.name: Pebble Grey Modern
palettes.app_note: Cooler counterpart to Greige Sanctuary — for cleaner, more architectural rooms.

palettes.name: Limewash Plaster
palettes.app_note: Mediterranean-modern hero — let the wall texture do the work.

palettes.name: Bone & Black
palettes.app_note: Modern bone-on-black — quiet drama without colour commitment.

palettes.name: Soft Blush & Bone
palettes.app_note: Modern blush — neutralised, not sweet. Reads as a warm neutral with rose undertones.

palettes.name: Dusty Sage & Cream
palettes.trend_source: Sage green — top-3 trending wall colour 2024-2026
palettes.app_note: Light sage — calmer than Mossy Green & Ochre, easier to live with.

palettes.name: Powder Blue & Linen
palettes.app_note: Light coastal modern — fresher and less expected than Hamptons blues.

palettes.name: Butter & Bone
palettes.app_note: Soft buttery yellow — modern not nostalgic. Pairs with cream walls beautifully.

palettes.name: Smoky Lavender
palettes.app_note: Smoky lavender — modernised mauve. Not sweet — reads as a warm purple-grey.

palettes.name: Almond Milk
palettes.app_note: Warm pale neutral — friendlier than Bone & Black, softer than Greige.

palettes.name: Chocolate Brown Modern
palettes.trend_source: Chocolate brown comeback — WGSN + Vogue Living 2026
palettes.app_note: The 2026 dark horse — chocolate brown is back. Read as warm-modern, not 70s.

palettes.name: Burgundy & Bone
palettes.app_note: Wine-dark accent palette — sophisticated rather than gothic.

palettes.name: Slate Blue Modern
palettes.trend_source: Slate blue — Benjamin Moore + Farrow & Ball 2025-2026
palettes.app_note: Modern slate blue — sophisticated grey-blue, neither cold nor sad.

palettes.name: Navy & Linen
palettes.trend_source: Classic navy — perennial top 5 paint colour
palettes.app_note: Tailored navy with linen warmth — classic that never dates.

palettes.name: Forest Green Classic
palettes.trend_source: Deep green — Farrow & Ball Studio Green territory
palettes.app_note: Deep forest green — library energy. Pairs with warm cream and brass.

palettes.name: Charcoal & Oak
palettes.app_note: Industrial-modern — softened by oak warmth so it doesn't go cold.

palettes.name: Japandi Quiet
palettes.app_note: Japandi — Scandinavian restraint with Japanese warmth. Always reads expensive.

palettes.name: Scandinavian White
palettes.app_note: Pure Scandi — white-on-white with light timber. Bright Nordic light.

palettes.name: Modern Mediterranean
palettes.app_note: Mediterranean modern — plaster walls, terracotta, olive, sun-baked palette.

palettes.name: Tuscan Cream
palettes.app_note: Heritage Tuscan — read carefully, can tip into 90s if overdone. Use as accents.

palettes.name: Desert Modern
palettes.app_note: Desert modern — sandstone, clay, bone. Australian outback meets Sedona.

palettes.name: Boho Earth
palettes.trend_source: Boho earth — Anthropologie / Free People aesthetic
palettes.app_note: Boho earth — rust, olive, mustard. Layered + lived-in.

palettes.name: Tropical Modern
palettes.app_note: Tropical modern — calm not jungle. Sage, soft green, warm cream.

palettes.name: Wabi-Sabi Cream
palettes.app_note: Wabi-sabi cream — celebrates imperfection. Pair with hand-thrown ceramics.

palettes.name: Art Deco Jewel
palettes.app_note: Art Deco — jewelled emerald, brass, blush. High-glamour period palette.

palettes.name: French Provincial
palettes.app_note: French provincial — soft blue, cream, faded gold. Pastoral and romantic.

palettes.name: Industrial Loft
palettes.app_note: Industrial loft — concrete and warm timber. Urban texture.

palettes.name: Cottage English
palettes.trend_source: English cottage — Farrow & Ball / British country
palettes.app_note: English cottage — soft yellow, sage, faded red. Garden-meets-parlour energy.

palettes.name: Bauhaus Primary
palettes.app_note: Bauhaus — cream + primary red + ink. Geometric, considered. Not maximalist.

palettes.name: Victorian Refined
palettes.trend_source: Victorian revival — heritage colour deep cuts
palettes.app_note: Victorian — deep teal, burgundy, brass. Layered period without going gothic.

palettes.name: Mustard & Cream
palettes.app_note: Mustard accent palette — mid-century cheerful without being twee.

palettes.name: Coral & Cream
palettes.app_note: Soft coral — sunset warmth. Reads as a warm neutral with peach lift.

palettes.name: Sage & Terracotta
palettes.app_note: Sage + terracotta — Mediterranean garden energy. Modern earthen.

palettes.name: Soft Lilac
palettes.app_note: Soft lilac — modernised pastel. Pair with bone + deep plum for grown-up read.

palettes.name: Sunset Ochre
palettes.app_note: Sunset ochre — warmer, richer alternative to Tuscan Cream. Modern read.

palettes.name: Aegean Blue & White
palettes.app_note: Aegean blue + crisp white — Greek-island coastal. Brighter than Hamptons.
